name: Write Session Handoff
summary: Capture verified working state so another agent can resume without reconstruction.
description: Write a concise session handoff containing objective, verified state, decisions, changed files, validation, dead ends, and next action. Use before context loss, agent transfer, or an intentional pause.
risk_reason: This skill captures verified working state so another agent can resume without reconstruction; it does not invent completed work, passing checks, or decisions.
refuses: It does not invent completed work, passing checks, or decisions.
It does not include credentials, private payloads, or unnecessary personal data.
It does not silently turn suggestions into instructions or authorization.

entrypoints.purpose: Collect revision, branch, upstream, working-tree, diff-statistic, and recent-commit evidence from Git without mutation.

operational.latency_reason: The skill captures verified working state so another agent can resume without reconstruction, using sequential evidence and verification steps.
